note: 'C' refers to the Phase 3.6 experimental candidate pool (agents/phase3_6/response_policy_v2.py, B1-B5) -- no Phase 3.6 candidate was ever promoted to production; this matrix evaluates that pool plus the option of NO CHANGE (keep Submission B's B0) against the now-larger 13-game Submission B evidence set.

weaknesses.description: Opponent sustained multi-resource (hands/animals) scaling; response fires but fixed magnitude insufficient against the largest real opponents
weaknesses.evidence_source: Real A+B replay JSON, detector re-run against exact observed opponent trajectories
weaknesses.b_frequency: 5/9 B losses (56%) -- UPDATED from the prior 2/3 sample; new evidence includes zixma13, the deleted-account game, iBooNDK, Achille Gohin (partially), Safin
weaknesses.c_expected_trajectory_effect: Positive but insufficient in magnitude (confirmed both via Phase 3.6 synthetic experiments AND now directly in real Submission B play -- e.g. moushun chen: response fired at day 5, we still lost by $48,162)
weaknesses.c_experimentally_validated: Real-world CONFIRMED (not just synthetic) that detection+response fires correctly but is insufficient against extreme opponents. Phase 3.6's 5 adaptive candidates (B1-B5), designed specifically to close this gap, ALL underperformed the existing fixed response (B0) in every synthetic test.
weaknesses.status: PARTIALLY SOLVED (by B0, unchanged) / NOT SOLVED (by any Phase 3.6 candidate -- none improve on B0)
weaknesses.confidence: HIGH for the trigger/fire facts (exact computation); MEDIUM for whether ANY tested response design would help (all tested designs failed)
weaknesses.remaining_risk: CRITICAL and UNCHANGED -- this is still the single largest, most frequent real weakness across both submissions, now with MORE evidence (5 new real B losses) and NO validated fix

weaknesses.description: Terminal cash-zero death spiral / no-recovery softlock: our cash and ALL crop tiles hit zero by day ~6-10 and NEVER recover for the remaining 20+ days, ending the game at exactly $0 -- against an opponent with almost NO scaling signature (2 hands, 0 animals, gradual land expansion to 4 quadrants, itself starting from a WORSE position than us on day 0: opponent $78 vs our $1,833)
weaknesses.evidence_source: Real replay JSON, episode 104775830 vs Arum Puri, full turn-by-turn reconstruction
weaknesses.a_frequency: 0/13 -- not observed in Submission A's dataset
weaknesses.b_frequency: 1/9 B losses (11%) -- NEW, first observed this round
weaknesses.severity: CRITICAL (worst possible outcome: total loss of all value, $0 final money -- the single worst final-money result across ALL 35 real episodes reviewed to date, worse even than any F-001 loss)
weaknesses.c_expected_trajectory_effect: N/A -- not a scaling mechanism, no existing detector watches for it
weaknesses.confidence: HIGH for the observation (exact, from real replay); LOW for the root cause (not diagnosed beyond 'cash and crops hit zero and never recover' -- whether this is a Planner v1 front-loading issue, an unlucky early sequence, a weed-spawn cascade, or something else was NOT determined this session)

Needs urgent root-cause investigation before any confident promotion decision, since a fix for F-001/F-003 that does nothing for this risk leaves the worst tail-risk scenario completely open.

weaknesses.a_frequency: 0/13 -- not observed in Submission A's dataset (or not distinguished from F-001 if present)
weaknesses.b_frequency: 1/9 B losses (11%) -- NEW, first observed this round

weaknesses.c_expected_trajectory_effect: Insufficient -- addresses only part of the opponent's actual advantage
